summary.text: Jeanine Driscoll, a Republican who is the Town of Hempstead Receiver of Taxes, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in New York's 4th Congressional District to Laura Gillen.
An attorney for over 30 years, she was an associate village justice in Bellerose before winning town-wide office in 2019.
Her campaign focused on restoring the full State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction and lowering the tax burden.

paragraphs.text: Driscoll lives in Bellerose, Nassau County, according to News 12.
She earned a B.A. in American government and politics from The Catholic University of America and a J.D. from Fordham University.
She worked as an attorney for more than 30 years before holding elected office, and served as an Associate Justice for the Village of Bellerose from 2015 to 2019.
Driscoll was elected Town of Hempstead Receiver of Taxes in 2019, taking office in 2020, and was re-elected in 2023.
According to her campaign website, as Receiver of Taxes she has helped homeowners with exemptions and lower assessments, and she serves over 95% of the 4th District.
After Nassau Republican Party leadership endorsed her, she won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary for NY-4.
She received 43.5% of the vote to Laura Gillen's 56.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
